purpose: Activation check: the skill should load for real tool choices and lifecycle questions, and stay quiet for defaults, version bumps, and CVE patching.
should_trigger: I need a managed Postgres for this side project, ideally with a free tier. What should I use?
Set up auth for this Next.js app. Clerk, Auth0, or something else?
Add transactional email to the signup flow.
We need a vector database for RAG. Can we self-host it?
Is this library still maintained? The last release looks old.
Should we switch from Jest to Vitest?
Pick a queue for background jobs on Cloudflare Workers.
Does Neon have an MCP server our agent can use?
Which error-monitoring service has a free tier and is SOC 2 compliant?
Did MediatR change its license? Can we still use it commercially?
should_not_trigger: Add a UUID to each record.
Bump lodash to the latest version.
Fix the Dependabot alert on axios.
Import json and parse this file.
Write a unit test for the parser.
Refactor this function to use async/await.
We already use Postgres on RDS; add an index to the users table.
